title: Cranberry Ukrainian Dumplings
description: Sweet and savory Ukrainian dumplings filled with a cranberry and cream cheese mixture, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Melt the cream cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the minced garlic and stir until combined.
Add the cranberries and cook until they start to soften.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and salt.
Add the egg mixture to the cream cheese mixture and stir until combined.
Add the dreamy cheese and stir until combined.
Place the dumpling wrappers on a clean surface.
Place a tablespoon of the cranberry mixture in the center of each wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
